This subduction zone has [produced many great earthquakes](https://web-archive-2022.iris.edu/hq/files/programs/education_and_outreach/retm/tm_150916_chile/150916_chile.pdf), including a magnitude 8.0 earthquake near Valparaíso in 1985. This means [Valparaíso is also exposed to large tsunamis ](https://cigiden.cl/el-tiempo-de-evacuacion-ante-tsunamis-en-chile-debe-reducirse-para-evitar-perdidas-humanas/). In 1730, an earthquake estimated at between magnitude 9.
